title: withdraw() silently increases the withdrawal amount when remaining would fall in (0, MINIMUM_STAKE), with no caller-visible warning
rootCause: Dust handler overrides the requested amount when `0 < user.amount - amount < MINIMUM_STAKE`, forcing a full withdrawal silently.
impactSummary: UX bug / minor footgun for integrators expecting partial cash-out. No security impact.
preservedDetails: CODE-014 carries the walkthrough and proposed remediation menu (revert vs event).
remediation: Revert with `'leaves dust'` so the caller chooses, or emit a `DustWithdraw(user, requested, actual)` event.
